metaDescription: Free online Pace Calculator. Calculate running pace from distance and time.
intro: Use our free online Pace Calculator tool. It determines running speed based on your inputs.
whatIs: The Pace Calculator is an online utility that determines running speed. It processes your distance and provides minutes per mile or kilometer.
howToUse: Enter your distance into the designated input field.
Provide any secondary parameters like time.
Click the calculate or submit button to generate minutes per mile or kilometer.
Copy or review the resulting output for your needs.
howItWorks: This tool operates in your browser by applying standard algorithms to your distance. It instantly processes the data to output minutes per mile or kilometer.
workedExample: For example: 10k in 50 mins = 5:00 min/km pace.
resultInterpretation: The result represents minutes per mile or kilometer. You can use this data for your specific calculations or formatting needs.
useCases: Quickly processing distance on the go
tipsAndLimitations: Treadmill pace can feel different than outdoor pace.
Ensure your inputs are formatted correctly for the best results.
The tool runs completely client-side, ensuring your data remains private.

faq.question: What is a sub-4 marathon pace?
faq.answer: Roughly 9 minutes and 9 seconds per mile.

faq.question: Is the Pace Calculator free to use?
faq.answer: Yes, our Pace Calculator is completely free and requires no registration.

faq.question: Does this work on mobile devices?
faq.answer: Yes, the tool is fully responsive and functions perfectly on all smartphones and tablets.
